--- Why this is vendored rather than CDN-loaded ---
lastapple.com does not put a third-party request on a page a prospect loads.
Pinned at 2.5.6 because that is the version the panorama geometry was validated
against by TOM on 2026-09-07. Upgrading means re-checking the viewer against the
measured haov/vaov/vOffset in content/skies/tioga-county-last-light.mdx.
Fetched from registry.npmjs.org/pannellum/-/pannellum-2.5.6.tgz (build/ only).
